title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 46 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 46)

content.overview: Section 46 provides that a foreign award enforceable under Chapter I is binding for all purposes on the persons between whom it was made and may be relied upon by them by way of defence, set-off or otherwise in legal proceedings in India.
